canonical_rule_home: Each major policy has one canonical Markdown procedure and at most one machine companion named in the manifest.
change_requirements: state why current policy fails or changed
update human and machine companions atomically
run instruction validator and relevant repository tests
duplication_rule: Pointers may summarize but must not create a second competing normative rule.
versioning: Semantic versioning for the instruction pack; major for authority/operating-model change, minor for backward-compatible capability, patch for clarification/fix.
